title: GitHub & delivery
summary: Connect repository integration, review, and release decisions to the verified Velclaw workflow.

sections.heading: GitHub integration is present
body: The source tree contains GitHub API routes and GitHub authentication/integration code, plus repository and pull-request UI components.

sections.heading: Prepare review
body: Keep proposed changes focused, inspect the diff, and provide enough context for reviewers to evaluate the change.

sections.heading: Deliver deliberately
body: Use build, lint, type-check, CI, and review signals before deciding that a change is ready to ship. External credentials and repository permissions are required for real GitHub delivery operations.

sections.heading: Keep traceability
body: Link implementation, validation, review, and release information so the delivery decision can be understood later.
